name: Beijing Jingyi Automation Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Jingyi Automation Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of high-end equipment primarily for use in the semiconductors, LED, LCD, and other fields. It offers semiconductor temperature control devices; wafer sorter, AMR, and vacuum robot products; local scrubber equipment; and other special equipment. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Beijing, China.
